Container.Name: TurboScript
Container.Overview:
TurboScript — AI audio and video transcription powered by OpenAI Whisper.
Drop any MP3, MP4, WAV, M4A, OGG, FLAC file and get a full transcription with timestamps.
Supports 99+ languages, auto-detection, translation to English, and export to TXT / SRT / VTT.
Powered by the free Groq API (whisper-large-v3-turbo). Get a free key at console.groq.com.
Set GROQ_API_KEY below to pre-configure it for all users on your network.

Config.Name: Web UI Port
Config.Description: Port for the TurboScript web interface. Access via http://[serverIP]:[port]

Config.Name: Groq API Key
Config.Description: [Recommended] Your Groq API key (free at console.groq.com). Pre-configures transcription for everyone on your network — no Settings step needed. Leave empty to let users enter their own key in the UI.
